english.text:

$$= (12 \times 10) + (12 \times 2)$$

english.q: What is the largest planet in our solar system?
english.text:
The largest planet in our solar system is **Jupiter**.

It is a gas giant that is significantly larger than all the other planets combined. Its radius is more than 11 times that of Earth, and its mass is more than two and a half times the mass of all the other planets in the solar system put together.

english.q: What is the chemical symbol for gold?

The chemical symbol for gold is **Au**.

This symbol originates from the Latin word *aurum*, which means "shining dawn" or "dawnstar." Although the first letter is "A" (like the English name), the second letter is "u" to represent the Latin root.

english.q: Who wrote Romeo and Juliet?
english.text:

The play is widely considered one of the greatest works of English literature.

english.q: How many minutes are in an hour?
english.text:
There are **60** minutes in an hour.

This is a standard unit of time measurement where 60 minutes make up one hour, and 60 hours make up one day.

english.q: Which ocean is the largest?
english.text:
The **Pacific Ocean** is the largest ocean on Earth.

It covers an area of approximately 165.25 million square kilometers (63.8 million square miles), which is roughly 46% of the planet's total surface area. The Pacific Ocean is also the deepest and most voluminous, containing the Mariana Trench, the deepest known point in the ocean. It is significantly larger than the second-largest ocean, the Atlantic Ocean.

english.q: What is the capital of Italy?
english.text:

As the country's primary political, economic, and cultural center, Rome is also one of the largest cities in the Mediterranean and has served as the capital since the founding of the Roman Republic in 509 BC. It is famous for its rich history, numerous ancient ruins, and world-renowned landmarks such as the Colosseum and the Vatican City, which is located within its borders.
